papers.title: Bio-Inspired Self-Supervised Learning for Wrist-worn IMU Signals (Bio-PM)
papers.what: Tokenizes wrist accelerometer signals into motion-aligned movement segments instead of fixed windows, then pretrains a Transformer by masked reconstruction, improving HAR macro-F1 by an average of 6 percent over same-corpus self-supervised baselines.
papers.builds_on: SSL for HAR 700K Person-days (Yuan 2024, RTMH75VW); Masked Autoencoders Theory (Zhang 2023, 6INGKIJV); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF)

papers.title: Wavelet-Driven Masked Multiscale Reconstruction for PPG Foundation Models (MMR)
papers.what: Pretrains a PPG foundation model by reconstructing masked wavelet coefficients across time-frequency scales, matching or beating prior PPG and time-series foundation models on 17 of 19 health tasks.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF); Masked Autoencoders Theory (Zhang 2023, 6INGKIJV); HeAR (Baur 2024, 3LA8GNCU)

papers.title: Hierarchical Control in Multi-Agent Games: LLM-based Planning and RL Execution
papers.what: Uses a pretrained LLM as a strategic controller that selects among pretrained RL skill policies, reaching a win rate statistically equal to a hand-built behavior tree (46.4 vs 51.5 percent) while both beat flat RL.
papers.builds_on: Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024, Z9WZPMNU); LATS (Zhou 2024, 77ERE7HA); Offline RL (Levine 2020, ZULLM3UF)

papers.title: When Is Compositional Reasoning Learnable from Verifiable Rewards?
papers.what: Defines a task-advantage ratio that characterizes which compositional problems RLVR can learn from outcome-only feedback, proving learnability when correct intermediate steps raise verification probability and suboptimal convergence otherwise.
